resources.string: Manage passwords
Manage passwords with ease
Keyguard is a secure password manager that\'s also nice to use. It works offline and syncs with Bitwarden® and KeePass (KDBX).
Can be used with any Bitwarden® installation. This product is not associated with the Bitwarden project nor Bitwarden, Inc. Bitwarden® is a registered trademark of Bitwarden Inc.
Essentials
Security
Your data
Power tools
Autofill: Fill usernames and passwords in apps and browsers, and save new logins as you sign in.
Passkeys: Create passkeys and sign in with them in apps, in browsers and on a nearby computer.
One-time passwords: Keep authenticator keys in your logins and get TOTP, HOTP, Steam and mOTP codes.
Generator: Create passwords, passphrases, usernames, email aliases, and SSH and GPG keys, with your own wordlists.
Search: Find items with phrases, exclusions and field qualifiers. Save the filters you use often.
Quick search: Find an item from any app with a global shortcut and copy its values.
Watchtower: Find leaked, reused and weak passwords, breached accounts, missing two-factor authentication, insecure websites, and duplicate or expiring items.
Unlock: Use the app password, or a faster method such as biometrics, a YubiKey or a security key.
SSH agent: Authenticate to servers and Git hosts with SSH keys that never leave your vault.
GPG agent and tools: Sign and decrypt with GPG keys that never leave your vault, from other apps or in Keyguard.
Environments (beta): Keep environment variables, such as API keys, in your vault and pass them to local tools and coding agents.
Multiple accounts: Sign in to several Bitwarden and KeePass accounts and see their items in one vault.
Self-hosted servers: Connect to your own server with single sign-on, client certificates and custom HTTP headers.
Offline: View your vault and add or edit items without a connection. Edits merge field by field on the next sync.
Import: Move your passwords from browsers and other password managers.
Credential exchange: Move passwords and passkeys directly between Keyguard and other apps on your device.
Export: Save items and their attachments to an encrypted ZIP archive or a KeePass database.
Backups: Keep versioned snapshots of your vault in a folder, on a WebDAV server or in S3-compatible storage.
Attachments: Upload files to your vault and preview images, text and ZIP archives without saving them to disk.
Sends: Share text or a file through a link that expires, with an optional password or access limit.
Wear OS: Read your items and one-time passwords on your watch, and sign in to watch apps.
Linked devices (beta): Sync app settings, such as email forwarders and wordlists, directly between your devices.
Advanced features: Bulk actions, field placeholders and URL overrides.
Interface: Material You design with light, dark and black themes.
Keyguard is also available for Linux, macOS and Windows.
